svg.text: Solid-state relay channel, from amplifier to one electrode pad
Panasonic AQW614A PhotoMOS (1 Form A + 1 Form B) on the backplane PCB; one of six identical channels
AQW614 R_on typ. 27 Ω, max. 50 Ω
Fluoropolymer / SiNₓ / Au pad / SiNₓ / Si
24 AWG ground lead from the J8 BNC shell to the Si substrate (silver epoxy) closes the circuit
Channel 1 shown (D3/D2 → IC1 → BUS1_HV → J1). LED 1 drives 7–8 (N.C.) and LED 2 drives 5–6 (N.O.), per the Panasonic AQW614 datasheet.
